text: get_idea_context fails on ideas with long descriptions: it searches with the description, over the 2000-character query limit
description: Found by Claude 2026-11-20 on ideas.commons-hub.at: get_idea_context for d4203221 returned a zod error "Too big: expected string to have <=2000 characters" at path query. The related-ideas lookup passes the idea's text and description as a search query, and the search procedure caps the query at 2000 characters. Fix: cut the query (text plus the beginning of the description) to the limit before searching, and add a test with a long description.

status.comment: Reproduced 2026-11-20 with get_idea_context(graph: aimparency, ideaId: d4203221). Not fixed yet.
